comment: Intel 80186 (1982) — 8086 + 12 new opcodes + silicon-quirk fixes (PUSH SP / shift mask). Phase 25 — first AprCpu CPU built via spec inheritance (doc #23). Spec authoring cost: ~250 lines of diff vs ~3000 line i8086 base. Validates the load-time merge mechanism end-to-end.

variants.notes: Intel 80186 — 8086 + 12 new opcodes (PUSHA/POPA/BOUND/IMUL imm/INS/OUTS/ENTER/LEAVE/shift-imm/PUSH imm) + silicon-quirk fixes (PUSH SP pre-decrement; shift count masked to 5 bits).
Intel 80188 — 80186 with 8-bit external bus (analogous to 8088 vs 8086). ISA-identical.
